ARES pairs record $36B fundraising and 17% AUM growth with near-universal analyst target hikes. AEE offers a reaffirmed guidance regulated utility with a $71B data-center-driven capex pipeline and raised targets. I skip top-ranked BEN (already at a 52-week high with valuation flags) and pass on EIX/ES given wildfire-reform downgrade risk and charge-driven earnings collapse.
